approved: Communications Legislation Amendment (SBS Advertising Flexibility) Bill 2017

The bill amends the SBS Act to allow up to 10 minutes of advertising per hour (capped at 120 minutes daily) and clarify rules for product placement, projected to raise $27.4 million over four years. The changes aim to increase SBS's commercial revenue and reduce its reliance on government funding without materially affecting commercial broadcasters.

The government decided not to proceed with the SBS Advertising Flexibility Bill, and instead provided SBS with an additional $8.8 million in the 2017‑18 budget, bringing total investment to over $280 million for that year.
